upload_large_folder: upload a large local folder to a Hugging Face Hub repository with resilient multi-worker upload
validate_upload_limits: validate file paths against repository limits for file count, folder entries, and individual file sizes
create_HfApi_repo: create a Hugging Face Hub repository if it does not already exist before uploading files
manage_workers_upload: manage concurrent worker threads that compute SHA256, fetch upload modes, preupload LFS, and commit files
generate_upload_report: generate a periodic status report showing hashed, pre-uploaded, and committed file counts with elapsed time
